provenance.alias_union_rule: ALIAS UNION (DECISIONS D31 opt (a1)): each requested/recorded symbol resolves to EVERY assets row whose NORMALIZED spelling matches (symbol.upper().replace('/', '') — slash-only, deliberately NOT XBT->BTC folding), and the group's ohlcv rows are unioned into the slot's single series at load time (NO DB writes — the ingest identity split is repaired at the loader). Where aliased series overlap in time the closes must AGREE (rel <= 1e-12) or the load REFUSES, naming both asset_ids and the first disagreeing timestamp — never average, never prefer silently; agreeing duplicate timestamps dedupe. Per-slot usage is disclosed (asset_ids / db_symbols / per_id_rows / overlap_agreement).
provenance.open_gate_rule: CAUSAL OPEN-GATE (DECISIONS D31 opt (a2)): a decision cell whose slot printed NO real close anywhere inside its feature bar is force-HELD (the shipped price_valid force-HOLD mechanic), on the pinned AND canon unpinned minute loaders uniformly. The mask is CAUSAL by construction — bar r's value reads only prints inside bar r, so the mask at decision t is identical whether or not rows after t exist (no look-ahead into whether a gap later resumes; that is also why TRAILING gaps are gated — at decision time a delisting and an interior hole are indistinguishable). WHAT THE FORCE-HOLD COVERS, stated exactly (regression-panel amendment): the channel holds the WHOLE action, not only the open — on a masked cell no position can OPEN and none can CLOSE or rebalance either, so a book already holding the slot is CARRIED through the frozen span at the D30 forward-filled valuation (PV-exact to the cent — the PV-conservation smoke leg, both books, mask ON) and realizes its PnL at the NEXT REAL print. That is the sound semantics, not an oversight: a close at a frozen price would realize PnL against a price no market offered — the same fabrication class the mask exists to remove — and a state-aware close-at-the-boundary channel is D30 opt (ii) TRUE LIQUIDATION, which the ruling keeps PARKED. 'The mask only gates OPENING' in the task text is the contrast with VALUATION (the fill still values every row), not a claim that closes execute on frozen cells. Conservative by construction: a masked cell cannot trade, so it can only reduce measured performance, never flatter it.
